```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
basque_vot <- read_csv("./data/egurtzegi2020/eu_vot.csv")


```

```{r}
basque_vot |>
  filter( 
    phone %in% c("ph", "kh", "th")) |>
  summarise(
    VOT_mean = round(mean(VOT)), VOT_sd = round(sd(VOT))
  )




```

```{r}
# fILTERED

basque_vot |>
  filter(
    phone %in% c("ph", "kh", "th")
  ) |>
  summarise(
    VOT_mean = mean(VOT),
    VOT_sd = sd(VOT)
  )
  

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)



 aspirated <- basque_vot |>
  filter( 
    phone %in% c("th", "ph", "kh")
  ) |>
  summarise(
    VOT_mean = mean(VOT, na.rm = TRUE),
    VOT_sd = sd(VOT, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 
 
 basque_vot |>
   ggplot(aes(VOT)) +
   geom_density() +
   labs(x = "Time (seconds)")
```

```{r}
library(brms)

pnorm(0.0325425, 0.01476197)

```

```{r}
basque_vot |>
  group_by(phone) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(VOT, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(VOT, na.rm = TRUE),
  )

vot_aspirated <- basque_vot |>
  filter(phone %in% c("th", "kh", "ph"))

vot_aspirated |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = VOT, colour = phone)) +
  geom_density() +
  labs(
    x = "time",
    y = "density"
  )
```
